body:
Coordinator rule for TRAINS (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-16 00:01Z, learned on train-2). A combined full gate credits ONLY the carrier item that is focused at launch; the multi-item credit fix w-540531f46f53 is unfixed, and Greg's #713 exception was one-time. Before push, condition 3 needs a fresh PASS evaluation for EVERY member. Opus2 rightly held train-2's push (4daa5b87 #2430).

What worked (about 20 minutes for 4 members): the Merger holds all members, and the train root is named for each. Then per member:
- turn A: a holder note on the item citing the gate run, the input fingerprint, the carrier's record and the commit. This moves the focus.
- turn B: a credited focused cargo test of that member's own tests in the train root.
- turn C: confirm the typed record, request the independent evaluation, and do the next member's turn A in the same turn.
Unbound "full gate passes on the exact tree" criteria cite the carrier's record by that note. I own each wake.

PLAN THIS BEFORE THE COMBINED GATE next time, and schedule the member runs in the same TermAl window as the gate's END, so the push isn't held.

RULING (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-16 22:28Z, train-3a, following the w-63d2 precedent). Condition 3 for a member whose ONLY non-passing criterion is landing-dependent ("full gate passes on the master tree containing the landed change") is met when: (1) a fresh evaluation shows every other criterion passing, (2) full-gate records exist on the EXACT commit tree, and (3) the push is a fast-forward, so master's tree equals that tree. The Merger re-evaluates those members right after the push so they close on recorded evidence; any failure other than "not yet on master" is fixed forward. Applied to train-3a's w-78f1, w-a776, w-dd0d, w-9b98 and w-63e7 (Opus2 4daa5b87 #2465).
